definition_used: One or more third parties objected to the notice or the wording of the notice.
caution: The reason describes a post-publication objection to the notice itself, not necessarily the underlying research content. It is a transparency/process signal, not a direct indicator of manuscript content issues.
semantic_rationale: The definition focuses on third-party objections to the notice or its wording, which directly relates to post-publication transparency and due process oversight. It does not inherently imply issues with research content, authorship, or editorial governance, though it may accompany such issues. The primary category is post_publication_transparency_due_process_oversight because the objection concerns the notice's transparency or wording.
